$comment: Hard stops enforced by the runner. Any breach aborts the stage immediately and writes an ABORTED report.

syntheticGeoSandbox.$comment: Synthetic gigs and users are placed here. Moved 2026-11-25 from Metro Manila to a small box near Basco, Batanes (far from the team's dev testers), because staging = the shared dev project and onOpenGigPosted pushes to available users within 10 km.

$latencyAbortNote: User decision 2026-11-23: on the emulator, latency reflects one local JVM (saturates ~50-60 concurrent sessions), so it never aborts a run there. Error-rate, read/write and run-time stops still apply. Billable environments keep abortOnP95LatencyMs.
$syntheticEmailDomainNote: Changed 2026-11-25 from loadtest.giggre.invalid: ~500 accounts on dev under the old domain were created by earlier failed runs with a different LOADTEST_PASSWORD_SALT and can't be signed in to. The new domain gives a clean set (prepare-accounts.mjs + firebase auth:import). Old-domain accounts still need removing from dev Authentication.
